name: dumbbell kroc row
description: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.
instructions: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
